tokens.name: color-surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, section bands, input fills behind content.

tokens.name: color-surface-default
tokens.usage: Cards and panels at elevation 0–1. In dark mode lighter = higher.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sticky headers (elevation 2–3; pair with shadow-2/3).

tokens.name: color-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers (elevation 4; pair with shadow-4).

tokens.name: color-surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips, inverse bands. Text on it: color-text-inverse.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Modal/Drawer (::backdrop).

tokens.name: color-text-default
tokens.usage: Body and headings on every color-surface-* except inverse.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, metadata on every color-surface-* except inverse (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast; never for information).

tokens.name: color-text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on color-surface-inverse.

tokens.name: color-text-link
tokens.usage: Inline and standalone links; always underlined inline. Polinom.io: violet (brand fill shades). TreatMint: Deep mint shades.

tokens.name: color-text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover/pressed.

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox, radio, switch-track outlines (≥3:1 on page and default surfaces).

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover outline of controls; selected outline of cards.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every surface (≥3:1), via :focus-visible. Polinom.io: violet. TreatMint: Deep mint shades.

tokens.name: color-action-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill, checked Switch track, Checkbox tint. One primary action per view. Hover and press are shown with an opacity-state layer of the label colour, not a separate token.

tokens.name: color-action-primary-fg
tokens.usage: Label and icon on color-action-primary-bg. Light: neutral-0. Dark: neutral-950.

tokens.name: color-action-secondary-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary Button fill, selected Tab pill, selected Tag.

tokens.name: color-action-secondary-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary hover; Ghost hover fill; icon-button hover. Shown together with a state layer.

tokens.name: color-action-secondary-fg
tokens.usage: Label on color-action-secondary-bg (both states) and Ghost/Tertiary label on surfaces.

tokens.name: color-action-destructive-bg
tokens.usage: Destructive Button fill: status-danger shade for the mode. Hover and press use the state layer.

tokens.name: color-action-destructive-fg
tokens.usage: Label on color-action-destructive-bg. Light: neutral-0 (Polinom.io 5.30:1). Dark: neutral-950.

tokens.name: color-brand-primary
tokens.usage: Brand primary (exact): decorative fills, illustration, chart series 1. Never text. Renamed from color-brand-accent.

tokens.name: color-brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Brand secondary (exact): decoration and illustration only. Never text.

tokens.name: color-brand-tertiary
tokens.usage: Brand tertiary (exact): decoration and illustration only. Never text.

tokens.name: color-brand-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted brand bands and badge backgrounds. Renamed from color-brand-accent-subtle.

tokens.name: color-accent-primary
tokens.usage: First emphasis tone: tone="primary" (default) on Card edge, Badge, Avatar, Progress. Text-safe on every surface. Polinom.io: magenta. TreatMint: Deep mint shades.

tokens.name: color-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Second emphasis tone: tone="secondary". Text-safe on every surface. Polinom.io: blue. TreatMint: Lavender shades.

tokens.name: color-accent-tertiary
tokens.usage: Third emphasis tone: tone="tertiary". Text-safe on every surface. Polinom.io: teal.

tokens.name: color-accent-quaternary
tokens.usage: Fourth emphasis tone: tone="quaternary". Text-safe on every surface. Polinom.io: clay.

tokens.name: color-feedback-success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and icon, on color-feedback-success-bg or any page surface. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: color-feedback-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success Alert/Banner and Toast fill.

tokens.name: color-feedback-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon, on color-feedback-warning-bg or any page surface. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: color-feedback-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning Alert/Banner and Toast fill.

tokens.name: color-feedback-danger-fg
tokens.usage: Danger / error text and icon, on color-feedback-danger-bg or any page surface. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: color-feedback-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger / error Alert/Banner and Toast fill.

tokens.name: color-feedback-info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text and icon, on color-feedback-info-bg or any page surface. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: color-feedback-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info Alert/Banner and Toast fill.

tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Cards, inputs and panels (light); label on dark fills. TreatMint: white.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Page (light). TreatMint: Mist pale.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Sunken surface and subtle line (light); text (dark). TreatMint: Line.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Muted text and control borders (dark); disabled text (light). TreatMint: Sage.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Muted text and control borders (light); disabled text (dark). TreatMint: Slate.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Subtle line (dark). TreatMint: Night line.

tokens.name: neutral-850
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Raised, sunken and overlay surfaces (dark). Polinom.io: the logo tile. TreatMint: Night raised.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Page (dark); text (light). Polinom.io: the logo ground #002b36. TreatMint: Night.

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Neutrals. Label on light fills (dark). TreatMint: same as neutral-900.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Brand. Primary identity colour: logo (top dot), illustration, decorative fills, chart series 1. Never text. Polinom.io: violet. TreatMint: Deep mint.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Brand. Secondary identity colour; decoration only, never text. Polinom.io: orange. TreatMint: Lavender.

tokens.name: brand-tertiary
tokens.usage: Brand. Tertiary identity colour; decoration only, never text. Polinom.io: cyan. TreatMint: same as brand-secondary (TreatMint has two brand colours).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Brand. Darkest brand tone. Polinom.io: same as neutral-900. TreatMint: Teal.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Brand. Lightest brand tone. Polinom.io: same as neutral-100. TreatMint: Mist.

tokens.name: brand-primary-fill-light
tokens.usage: Brand. Primary button fill, links and focus ring in light mode (Polinom.io: violet shade, label neutral-0 5.72:1). TreatMint: Teal (same as brand-deep), primary button only.

tokens.name: brand-primary-fill-dark
tokens.usage: Brand. Primary button fill, links and focus ring in dark mode (Polinom.io: violet shade, label neutral-950 6.86:1). TreatMint: Deep mint (same as brand-primary), primary button only.

tokens.name: accent-primary-light
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="primary" (light mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: magenta. TreatMint: Deep mint shade.

tokens.name: accent-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="primary" (dark mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: magenta. TreatMint: Deep mint shade.

tokens.name: accent-secondary-light
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="secondary" (light mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: blue. TreatMint: Lavender shade.

tokens.name: accent-secondary-dark
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="secondary" (dark mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: blue. TreatMint: Lavender shade.

tokens.name: accent-tertiary-light
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="tertiary" (light mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: teal. TreatMint: gold shade.

tokens.name: accent-tertiary-dark
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="tertiary" (dark mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: teal. TreatMint: gold shade.

tokens.name: accent-quaternary-light
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="quaternary" (light mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: clay. TreatMint: orchid shade.

tokens.name: accent-quaternary-dark
tokens.usage: Accents. tone="quaternary" (dark mode): card edge, badge, avatar, progress; text-safe (≥4.5:1). Polinom.io: clay. TreatMint: orchid shade.

tokens.name: status-success-light
tokens.usage: Status. Success text and icon (light mode); always with an icon and a word. Polinom.io: dark green. TreatMint: cyan.

tokens.name: status-success-dark
tokens.usage: Status. Success text and icon (dark mode); always with an icon and a word. Polinom.io: dark green. TreatMint: cyan.

tokens.name: status-warning-light
tokens.usage: Status. Warning text and icon (light mode); always with an icon and a word. Polinom.io: ochre. TreatMint: amber.

tokens.name: status-warning-dark
tokens.usage: Status. Warning text and icon (dark mode); always with an icon and a word. Polinom.io: ochre. TreatMint: amber.

tokens.name: status-danger-light
tokens.usage: Status. Danger text and icon (light mode); always with an icon and a word. Also destructive actions. Polinom.io: crimson. TreatMint: red.

tokens.name: status-danger-dark
tokens.usage: Status. Danger text and icon (dark mode); always with an icon and a word. Also destructive actions. Polinom.io: crimson. TreatMint: red.

tokens.name: status-info-light
tokens.usage: Status. Info text and icon (light mode); always with an icon and a word. Polinom.io: blue. TreatMint: blue.

tokens.name: status-info-dark
tokens.usage: Status. Info text and icon (dark mode); always with an icon and a word. Polinom.io: blue. TreatMint: blue.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Hero headline (MKT-01). Clamp down to display-md under 640px. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 700.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: CTA section and feature headers. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 700.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Page title (H1). Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 600.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Section title (H2). Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 600.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Subsection (H3/H4), FAQ group titles. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 600.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Card, Modal, Drawer titles. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 600.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: List item primary text, Accordion header. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 600.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Buttons, Tabs, form Labels, Menu items. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 500.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Small buttons, Tags/Chips, Badges. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, wght 500.

styles.name: code-md
styles.usage: Code block, Kbd. Hack — the only role not set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gap in small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (sm); list item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (md); card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; form field stack gap; grid gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on desktop; group spacing inside sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Spacing between content groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (marketing pages).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media, tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox, Tag, Badge, Kbd.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, sheets, hero media.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, Switch, Avatar, Icon button (round).

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Elevation 1: interactive cards at rest. Dark mode: rely on color-surface-default tone.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Elevation 2: card hover, sticky header.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Elevation 3: menus, popovers, tooltips (with color-surface-raised).

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Elevation 4: modals, drawers (with color-surface-overlay).

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of sm Button/Input (web only; below touch minimum — pad hit area).

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Height of md Button/Input (default on web).

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of lg Button/Input; default on Flutter/native.

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (iOS 44pt; Android/Flutter use 48dp).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in sm controls and inline text.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in md controls.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons, navigation.

tokens.name: border-width-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and input outlines.

tokens.name: border-width-thick
tokens.usage: Selected card outline, active Tab indicator.

tokens.name: border-width-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (outline, with 2px offset).

tokens.name: opacity-state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer over a control on hover (Flutter/Compose overlay).

tokens.name: opacity-state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer on press.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls when no dedicated disabled color exists.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Default stacking.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky header (NAV-01).

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Non-top-layer fallbacks only; Popover API/dialog use the top layer.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Small tablets and large phones.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet portrait; 8-column grid.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop; 12-column grid.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width (Container lg).

tokens.name: icon-weight
tokens.usage: Phosphor weight for every icon at rest (both brands in Phase 1). Theme-ready: a brand may switch weight later without component changes.

tokens.name: icon-weight-selected
tokens.usage: Phosphor weight for the selected/active state only: selected Tab, Bottom navigation item, toggled Icon button.

tokens.name: icon-viewbox
tokens.usage: Phosphor source grid (viewBox 0 0 256 256). Render at size-icon-sm|md|lg; regular weight draws 1.5px at 24px.

meta.source: Colour v0.29 (5 Nov 2026), rebuilt from scratch: four primitive categories with the same slots in both brands (Neutrals, Brand, Accents, Status). Polinom.io: neutrals from the logo ground #002b36; brand violet, orange, cyan (the logo colours); accents magenta, blue, teal, clay; new status colours. TreatMint: unchanged from v0.26. Structure: polinom-design-system-spec.md
